title: Account, Tools and Access: Cloud Shell & gcloud — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces a gcloud CLI command lifecycle: from local OAuth token acquisition across Google API Gateway to resource provisioning and immutable Cloud Audit Log emission.
routing_rationale: The Google Cloud API Gateway validates authentication, project billing activation, and Service Usage enablement before routing commands to service-specific backends.

nodes.label: gcloud auth cache
nodes.detail: Stores active account email, refresh token, and short-lived access token.

nodes.label: Google OAuth Server
nodes.detail: Issues 60-minute scoped JWT bearer tokens signed with Google private keys.

nodes.label: Service Usage API
nodes.detail: Verifies that compute.googleapis.com is enabled in the target project.

nodes.label: Compute Engine API
nodes.detail: Executes declarative resource creation and initiates asynchronous long-running operation.

steps.title: Token Refresh
steps.action: gcloud CLI detects token expiration (55 min old) and requests fresh token.
steps.why_traversal: Short-lived tokens limit exposure if client workstations are compromised.

steps.title: Service Check
steps.action: Google API Gateway confirms compute.googleapis.com is active on project.
steps.why_traversal: Projects must explicitly activate services to manage billing and API quotas.

steps.title: Resource Mutation
steps.action: Compute API accepts configuration and returns LRO (Long Running Operation) ID.
steps.why_traversal: Asynchronous operations prevent client timeout during multi-second hardware bootstrapping.

scenarios.label: API Service Disabled (403)
scenarios.root_cause: compute.googleapis.com was never activated in new Google Cloud project.
scenarios.diverted_path: API call rejected with HTTP 403 Access Not Configured.
scenarios.blast_radius: Terraform apply or CLI deployment halts immediately.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
